title: Sony 131.0 mm f/None full-frame imaging lens (numerical example 4)

collection.attribution: Sony Group Corp, US20240061211A1 "Imaging lens and imaging apparatus". The prescription is the published numerical example 4; the native Project is a transcription of its table.
collection.redistribution: The numerical prescription is published in a patent application, a public record. The transcription, the native Project and this evidence extract are distributed under MIT. The patent document itself is not redistributed.

aperture_validity.basis: The publication states no clear or mechanical semi-diameter, so the transcription uses one uniform 13 mm clear semi-diameter; the stop row is then the same size as its neighbours and does not bound the beam.
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: No pupil or field evidence is recorded, and the modelled stop does not bound the beam, so no stop-dependent match is claimed.
aperture_validity.consequence: The record supports first-order and structural queries only; a stop-dependent constraint stays unconfirmed.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: The publication prints the d-line as its reference wavelength (587.56 nm in air). That value is converted once to the vacuum wavelength the engine evaluates; the same conversion is used by the existing patent-derived records.
spectrum.wavelength_precision: A single sample; no rounding in the Project.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: The example states one reference wavelength only.

image_format.basis: The example states an image height Y = 21.633 mm; twice that is the tested image-circle diameter, consistent with a 36 x 24 mm frame.

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Effective focal length as printed for the example

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial distance from the exit vertex to the rear focal point

total_track_mm.definition: Sum of the tabulated thicknesses from the first surface to the image plane in the committed Project.

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD through the committed Project at the reference wavelength.

comparison.rule: |engine - source| <= atol + rtol * |source|. atol covers the printed 3-decimal focal length; rtol covers the printed 4-decimal radii and thicknesses, the constant-index material model and the engine's air-referenced index convention (about 0.13 % on EFL).

back_focal_length.basis: The publication prints no back focal length, so this quantity has no source value.

f_number.convention: Image-space F-number as printed for the example (Fno).

approximations.statement: Each element is a constant index equal to its printed nd, valid only at the reference wavelength; the printed vd values are kept in the evidence extract but are not modelled.
The publication states no semi-diameters; the Project uses one uniform 13 mm clear semi-diameter for every surface, which does not affect first-order properties.
The Project is the infinity-focus state; the printed focusing gaps (d1..d4 at other magnifications) are kept in the evidence extract.

record_hash_method: SHA-256 over the record body with record_hash and record_hash_method removed, serialized as json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) in UTF-8 with no trailing newline.
